scenario.title: Medium · Regional equipment shipment
scenario.brief: Compare four supplied quotations for delivering 160 boxed monitoring devices from Casablanca to Madrid. Select the lowest-cost feasible option. Every unit must arrive by the deadline, and transit insurance is mandatory. Prices are fictional all-in quotations in USD; customs and handling are included. Do not substitute market estimates or assume extra capacity.

options.terms: The quotation includes airport handling at both ends, customs processing, transit insurance, and the final delivery to the Madrid distribution centre. The stated capacity is the confirmed allocation for this booking, rather than a general aircraft capacity.

A scheduled sea crossing is followed by consolidated road delivery. Insurance and destination handling are included. The arrival is after the requested deadline; the carrier has not offered an earlier slot at this price.

A dedicated vehicle crosses by ferry and continues to the Madrid receiving facility. The quoted amount includes the ferry reservation, customs handling, cargo insurance, and delivery. The allocation covers exactly the required consignment.

This quotation meets the date and capacity requirements but explicitly excludes transit insurance. No insurance add-on has been quoted. Evaluate the supplied offer as it stands; do not invent a premium to make it compliant.
